title: Person Record
description: A human being. Payload field names follow schema.org Person, snake-cased, matching the original mdm.person shape. Relationships that were fields on the old record (primary_location, parents, manager) are now `relations` entries; employment is its own record type. v2: family links are relations edges (rel parent | child | spouse | sibling | guardian) for simple cases, or relationship records when dates/notes matter. Employments (any number, current and past) are employment records. Personal contact goes in data.contact; work contact belongs on the employment.

pii.description: Person records always contain personal information. Required AND fixed to true, so retention and subject-access sweeps cannot miss one - a const alone would let an author omit the field entirely.

person_data.description: Additional properties are permitted so a source system can round-trip extra fields; promote anything durable into a named property here.

honorific_prefix.description: Title before the name, e.g. Dr., Capt.

honorific_suffix.description: Suffix after the name, e.g. Jr., PE, PhD.

full_name.description: Complete name as normally written. Keep it even when derivable from the parts - name order is not universal, and the envelope `label` may be styled differently (e.g. 'Dietz, Cameron').

birth_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Sensitive: consider visibility=restricted, or omit entirely for records that feed public directories.

roles.description: Functional roles independent of any employer, e.g. 'incident commander', 'notary'. Job titles belong on the employment record.

skills.description: Capabilities and qualifications. Certifications with expiry dates deserve their own record type rather than a bare string here.

contact.description: Personal contact methods. Work contact belongs on the employment record, because it changes when the job does.

preferred.description: How the person prefers to be contacted.

pronouns.description: Pronouns the person uses, as they state them.

contact_points.description: All ways to reach them, any number and any kind (mobile, fax, second email, social handles). The single fields above stay as shortcuts that older apps read.
